question: The registry of The Supreme Court is headed by who among the following?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Secretary General**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Secretary General is the head of the registry of the Supreme Court of India and is the highest-ranking official after the Chief Justice of India.
 
• The Secretary General is responsible for the administration of the court and manages the registry, which includes case management and court procedures.
 
• The appointment of the Secretary General is made by the Chief Justice of India, and the position is typically held by a senior judicial officer
